From them, the law's lines: a_0 = sqrt 3 / (m* alpha_law) = 14.47 Links with m* = 3 tan omega_0 = 3.354, the 1s binding m* (alpha_law c)^2 / 2 = 7.12 x 10^-4 rad per interval below the free rest rotation omega_0 = 0.8411 (2 cos omega_0 = 4 / 3), the 2s a quarter of it, 1.78 x 10^-4; the sign row's level of one nucleus quantum, 3 s / (4 pi r) with s = k_w / (2 E_s) = 518 per interval, 123.7 levels at 1 Link, 8.8 at 14 and 4.4 at 28, the angle k_r L / Gamma reproducing alpha_law c / r at every r (2.06 x 10^-2 rad at 1 Link, 1.47 x 10^-3 at 14), one level 1 / Gamma = 1.67 x 10^-4 rad, so the 1s binding is 4.3 levels of the row. The electron's count: the law's count 1 (one quantum over N_eff = pi a_0^3 = 9,510 Nodes, c_i = 1.05 x 10^-4 at the centre) gives the amplitude A = sqrt(T c_i / (2 sin omega_s)) = 26 levels, its tail at one level at r = a_0 ln A = 47 Links (a 95-cube) and the walk sigma sqrt(n) / A = 19 percent over 10^3 intervals against the 1 to 4 percent asked, the budget's least T 2^20 at [1, 25] and 2^24 at [1, 100] against the energy line's 9.3 x 10^6: the count-1 atom at alpha_law = 1 / 28 is not representable under the law's own lines together (the energy line fixing T, the budget asking a larger one), a finding by name; a body of 30,000 electron quanta in the 1s mode (c_i = 3.2 at the centre, A = 4,440 under this universe's bound A = 4,963, the loader's at T = 9.3 x 10^6, the walk 1.1 x 10^-3) fits the budget (the least T 2^22 at [1, 100]) but its tail at one level reaches 121 Links (a 243-cube, beyond the engine's hour) and its Wronskian, 3 x 10^4 quanta's, turns the nucleus's record by an angle no atom has, the count-1 rule broken by 3 x 10^4 as the committed charged worlds break it. The worlds are declared on the 31-cube (the Boss's estimate; the 1s tail cut at 15 Links = 1.04 a_0, where e^(-r / a_0) = 0.35 of the peak, so the open faces hold the mode and no 1s mode of the law stands on it; the least odd board holding the tail at one level is 95^3 at the count 1 and 243^3 at 30,000), with the electron body of 30,000 quanta and the lay `fixed_point` at the tolerance [1, 100]. THE NUCLEUS: one Node, one quantum of the nucleus family (matter's pair as a plane), a DECLARATION by name: the world's holders give its six Link factors G^2 = 256 and not 0 (the tension lines start at 0 and no holder's level reaches Gamma), and its Links' reads R = 2 num p_i^2 Q are not 0 (num = 4000), so the one-Node record is no exact rotating pixel and spreads at the band's group velocity from the first interval; the exact rotating pixel needs a pair of num 0 (R = 0, 2 cos omega = 0, the period 4, exact to the bit), which the energy line refuses beside the electron's pair (E_s T num = k_w Gamma den fails at num = 0; the plane families of one world share num / den), or the compact body of line 2 in the nuclear holder's well, not built.
